api_5xx_checkout.title: Checkout 5xx surge
steps: Confirm the blast radius of the failure before assigning severity.
If most customers cannot complete checkout, declare P0 and page the payments on-call.
Check for a deployment within the last 60 minutes. A recent deployment is rollback context, not a reason to lower severity.
Open an incident channel and notify customer support.
Roll back or disable the suspect deploy only after incident-commander approval.
api_5xx_checkout.severity_guidance: Widespread production checkout failure is P0 and requires escalation.
